name: Yauhen's Android apps
description: Personal Android apps: Wahoo Share and Weather Widget.

apps.name: Wahoo Share
apps.summary: Send locations and cycling routes to your Wahoo ELEMNT
apps.description: Share locations and cycling routes with Wahoo ELEMNT. Find nearby water, toilets, bicycle repair, cafes and shops. Requires the Wahoo companion app for forwarding destinations.

apps.name: Weather Widget
apps.summary: Rain and weather forecasts on your home screen
apps.description: Home-screen weather widget showing rain and weather forecasts. Requires a reachable weather server; the default is https://weather.yauhen.cc. Configure the server and location when adding the widget.
